description: `doc-detective validate` checks test files without running them: 0 all valid, 1 any invalid, 2 none found (ADR 01206).

tests.description: Writes the inputs, then checks each exit code. One test, so the steps run in order: separate tests could race the setup under concurrentRunners.

steps.description: Writes the files the other tests check.

runShell.command:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='.tmp/fixture-validate';fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(d+'/empty',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(d+'/ok.spec.json',JSON.stringify({tests:[{steps:[{runShell:'echo ran > .tmp/fixture-validate/ran.txt'}]}]}));fs.writeFileSync(d+'/bad.spec.json',JSON.stringify({tests:[{steps:[{clik:'x'}]}]}));fs.writeFileSync(d+'/ok.md','# Doc

<!-- test
testId: t
-->

<!-- step runShell: echo hi -->
');fs.writeFileSync(d+'/bad.md','# Doc

<!-- test
testId: t
-->

<!-- step clik: x -->
');fs.writeFileSync(d+'/empty/readme.md','# Nothing to test
');"

steps.description: Valid specs and inline tests exit 0, and nothing runs.
Valid specs and inline tests exit 0, and nothing runs.
An invalid spec file exits 1 and names the bad action.
An invalid inline test in Markdown exits 1.
--json prints the verdict as one JSON document.
A folder with no tests exits 2.
